verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's docs say developers can 'get started quickly' with SDKs and prebuilt UIs, follow step-by-step integration instructions, and explore the APIs via a Postman collection. That supports a docs-driven payment integration, but the evidence never shows copy-paste code samples, which languages are covered, or any timing evidence that integration fits in under a day. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code examples per language, list of supported SDK languages, independent or hands-on corroboration of a sub-one-day integration, and a complete end-to-end payment-flow quickstart.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
